fields.value: Vajram ESTEVA is a three and four-bedroom ultra-luxury condominium project located in Mararthahalli – Sarjapur ORR. Approved by BBMP, the project offers an unparalleled urban lifestyle comes with a fine mixture of retail store and residential spaces housed within the same project. Located in one of the city’s most strategic zones, Vajram ESTEVA is within close proximity to 8 major tech parks revolutionizing the concept of connectivity to work place towards achieving a work-life balance.
